Permanent Marker is a hybrid strain; a fusion of several well-established cultivars: Biscotti x Sherb Bx x Jealousy. You’ll likely feel an initial euphoria that makes you feel happy and uplifted, but as the high progresses, it shifts into a deep, sedative relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that’s great for winding down after a long day or just chilling out. Permanent Marker is also known for its potential to help with stress, pain, and insomnia. If you’re looking to relax and kick back without feeling too energetic or jittery, this strain is a solid choice. It can also give you a serious case of the munchies, so keep some snacks handy. Overall, Permanent Marker is a great pick if you’re into bold flavors and a heavy, relaxing high. It’s got a unique profile that makes it stand out, and it provides a chill, comfortable experience that’s perfect for unwinding. products.description: Quattro Kush THCa Flower Strain Quattro Kush is an Indica-dominant hybrid THCa strain known for its potent effects and robust flavors. It is a cross between three notable strains: 707 Headband x Triangle Kush x SFV OG Kush. The breeders behind this strain are Ethos Genetics. Quattro Kush THCa Flower made its appearance on the market through their efforts. Indica-dominant strains are typically associated with relaxation and sedation; Quattro Kush aligns with this profile. It leans heavily towards the indica side effects, offering a calming and relaxing experience. Click here for COA Appearance The appearance of Quattro Kush buds showcases the typical traits associated with indica strains. They tend to be dense and compact, often tightly packed. The flowers are typically vibrant green in color, adorned with a generous covering of trichomes that give them a frosty appearance. The strain may also feature hints of purple or orange, adding to its visual appeal. Aroma/Flavor Quattro Kush exhibits a complex and enticing aroma derived from its parent strains. The scent is spicy and skunky, with hints of diesel inherited from the 707 Headband. The earthy scents of Triangle Kush help mellow out the overall aroma. At the same time, SFV OG Kush contributes fresher citrus and pine flavors. The flavor profile of Quattro Kush is a harmonious combination of various elements. Spicy, woody notes dominate upon inhaling, followed by a subtle sweetness reminiscent of pears, which helps balance the intensity. There are herbal undertones on the exhale with a touch of tea-like flavors. Effects Quattro Kush THCa Flower is known for its powerful effects, so users should be prepared for an intense experience. It is popular among experienced cannabis enthusiasts who seek a more potent strain. Still, it can also be enjoyed by beginners in smaller doses. As an Indica-dominant strain, Quattro Kush delivers a profoundly relaxing and calming high. Users can expect a head-emptying effect that promotes a carefree and blissful state of mind upon consumption. The strain has euphoric properties that can induce laughter and make social interactions more enjoyable. Additionally, Quattro Kush stimulates appetite, so users may experience the case of munchies. It can be an excellent choice for relaxed gatherings with friends or indulging in stoned cooking sessions. Quattro Kush is best suited for expe

products.description: Total Cannabinoids: 27.03% THCA: 26.04% Δ-9 THC: Apple Scotti THCA is closely related to the Biscotti lineage, and offers a complex aroma and flavor. The wide array of scent notes include sugar apple pastries, gassy diesel fuel, spiced herbs and earthy cookie dough, creating an intriguing sensory experience. The effects of this strain are two-fold; beginning with an uplifting bubbly feeling and relaxing into a calm and warm tranquil state. In its raw form, THCA is non-psychoactive, meaning it does not produce the intoxicating effects commonly associated with THC. However, when exposed to heat, such as through smoking, vaping, or decarboxylation (a process that involves heating the plant material), THCA converts into THC, becoming psychoactive. *Due to the THC present, we recommend that you find what dosage works for you in a comfortable environment and avoid operating heavy machinery.* These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug administration. products.description: Blue Dream is a sativa dominant hybrid made by crossing Blueberry and Haze. This strain known for its balanced and cerebral effects and full-body relaxation. It has gained a strong following in the cannabis community due to its well-rounded qualities. Blue Dream's exact breeder remains somewhat uncertain, but it is widely believed to be the creation of Santa Cruz-based breeder DJ Short, who is renowned for his work in the cannabis industry. The strain's genetics are linked to DJ Short's Blueberry and a Haze strain, resulting in a hybrid known for its harmonious effects. Blue Dream's aroma is often described as a harmonious blend of earthy, fruity, and floral notes. When you take a whiff, you may detect hints of sweet berries, followed by a subtle earthiness that rounds out the scent. The aroma is inviting and captivating, making Blue Dream one of the most sought-after strains for its pleasant fragrance. The flavor profile of Blue Dream mirrors its aroma. It typically offers a delightful mix of sweet blueberry, floral undertones, and a mild earthy note on the exhale. These flavors make it an appealing choice for those who appreciate a pleasant taste while enjoying its balanced effects. Featured Flower Sativa Type 1 Flow Gardens

products.description: NEW RESTOCK Ice Cream Breath x Shoreline is a bold and aromatic hybrid that captures the laid-back luxury of a coastal getaway. This strain greets the senses with a creamy, skunky sweetness layered with notes of diesel, pine, and subtle floral funk—like a seaside ice cream truck parked near a blooming shoreline. On the inhale, expect a rich, velvety flavor of vanilla cream swirled with earthy herbs and a salty tang reminiscent of ocean air. Hints of fuel and sour citrus add complexity, making each puff a flavorful journey from indulgent to invigorating. The effects of Ice Cream Breath x Shoreline lean into deep relaxation without losing clarity. It kicks off with a hazy, happy headspace—great for conversation, introspection, or watching the waves roll in. Gradually, a soothing body buzz takes over, easing physical tension while keeping your energy grounded and balanced. Whether you’re chilling at sunset or winding down after a long day, this strain is ideal for those who appreciate flavor-forward hybrids with a mellow, euphoric edge. Perfect for creative flow, mellow hangs, or simply savoring the calm. Flower Type 1 Flow Gardens

products.description: Aloha Sugar - Lively Island-Inspired Hybrid Aloha Sugar is a sativa-dominant hybrid that delivers a bright, uplifting character with a gentle grounding finish; its dense, resinous buds display deep emeralds threaded with honeyed amber pistils and a frosty coating of trichomes. The bouquet opens with warm citrus and tropical sugar notes that give way to subtle floral and spicy undertones, while the flavor is clean, sweet, and slightly peppered on the exhale — a refined, natural profile that feels premium and approachable. Terpene Profile The aroma and effects of Aloha Sugar are shaped by a balanced terpene blend: Limonene : Offers a clear, citrus brightness that lifts the aroma and promotes an energetic, sunny sensation. Myrcene : Grounds the profile with soft, fruity earthiness and a smoothening, mellowing presence. Caryophyllene : Adds warm, peppery spice and a rounded, comforting depth to the overall bouquet. Effects Aloha Sugar unfolds with a buoyant, focused uplift that encourages creativity and sociability, then eases into a relaxed, centered calm that keeps the body comfortable without clouding the mind; ideal for daytime to early-evening moments when you want clarity, warmth, and a touch of island ease. products.description: MJ Mintz by Shop Hello Mary is cool, clean, and unmistakably fresh — a mint-forward hybrid that hits smooth and leaves a lasting impression. This exotic indoor strain blends Bubba Kush x Animal Mints , creating dense, frosty buds with an earthy sweetness and that signature minty finish. Expect a balanced high that starts with a clear, uplifting spark before easing into full-body calm — perfect for winding down without slowing all the way down. Flavor, aroma, and design all come together in one refreshingly elevated experience. ◆ Bubba Kush x Animal Mints ◆ Indica-Dominant Hybrid ◆ Premium Indoor Flower MJ Mintz THCa Premium Flower MJ Mintz, a slightly indica-dominant hybrid from Bubba Kush x Animal Mints, delivers a chill, happy high that relaxes your body while keeping your mind clear and engaged. Sweet, skunky flavors meet a crisp, minty exhale with savory herbal undertones, making each puff rich and satisfying. Fluffy forest green buds flecked with golden hairs and sparkling trichomes complete this smooth, tingly experience — perfect for stress relief, mood boost, or unwinding after a long day. *This product complies with the 2014 and 2018 Farm Bills, containing no more than 0.3% Delta-9 THC by dry weight. The high begins with an uplifting, creatively energized headspace before settling into a warm, calming body relaxation that stays functional. Linalool: Infuses a floral, lavender-like scent, contributing significantly to the strain's calming and relaxing effects. This combination of terpenes crafts Alien Grapes' unique, memorable aroma and plays a crucial role in its potent, soothing effects. products.description: Strain Profile Banana Runtz THCA Flower is a deliciously tropical hybrid that blends the candy-coated sweetness of Runtz with the creamy fruitiness of Banana OG . The cultivar produces dense, colorful buds with a bright inviting aromatic profile blending ripe banana, tropical fruit, and sugary candy layered over subtle notes of vanilla and spice. Effects Banana Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for daytime use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright tropical character that distinguishes banana-Runtz crosses. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe banana up front, with tropical fruit through the middle and a sugary vanilla finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads banana-and-tropical — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Banana Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Banana Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Banana Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Black Magic THCA Flower is a mysterious hybrid known for its dark, dense buds and unusually layered aromatic profile. The cultivar produces structurally premium flower with the kind of deep color expression and complex flavor character that distinguishes connoisseur-grade exotics — bag appeal first with intriguing flavor depth. Effects Black Magic delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of unusual character that distinguishes flavor-led hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: deep dark fruit up front, with earthy spice through the middle and a warm gas-herb finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably layered. The terpene profile reads dark-fruit-and-earth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Black Magic harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Black Magic THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Black Magic THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Nerds THCA Flower is an award-winning hybrid bred for both flavor character and balanced effects. The buds carry vibrant blue-purple expression with a candy-sweet aromatic top note — visually distinct and structurally premium, the kind of cultivar that earns shelf space on looks alone. Effects Blue Nerds delivers a balanced, focus-friendly high that pairs calming euphoria with light energizing lift. The cerebral side stays clear and creative without anxious tension; the body baseline relaxes without becoming heavy — making this a strong daytime productivity cultivar that doesn't slow you down. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet berry-candy up front, with sugary citrus-fruit notes through the middle and a clean, slightly tangy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-leaning. The terpene profile reads candy-fruit with bright top notes — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Nerds harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Nerds THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Nerds THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. products.description: Strain Profile Chem Dog THCA Flower — also known as Chemdawg — is one of the most legendary and influential strains in cannabis culture, revered for its mysterious origins and unmistakably pungent, diesel-forward aroma. The cultivar produces dense, structurally classic buds with a complex terpene profile blending sharp chemical and fuel notes layered over earth and sour citrus. Effects Chem Dog delivers a balanced experience that pairs sharp cerebral lift with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels assertive and clear-headed — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of classic character that built the modern Chem-line category. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: pungent diesel fuel up front, with sharp chemical funk through the middle and a sour earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably classic. The terpene profile reads diesel-and-chem — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Chem Dog harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Chem Dog THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. products.description: Strain Profile Cookie Monster THCA Flower is a legendary, award-winning Indica-dominant cultivar renowned for delivering the ultimate heavy-hitting relaxation. A powerhouse cross between the world-famous Girl Scout Cookies and the deeply sedative OG Kush, this strain is an absolute titan in both appearance and potency. The buds are chunky, resinous, and exceptionally dense, boasting a dark and moody color palette of deep forest greens, midnight-purple undertones, and a thick nesting of fiery copper pistils. True to its cookie heritage, every single nook and cranny is heavily encrusted in a glittering, sticky layer of high-THCA trichomes that looks almost like a dusting of powdered sugar. Effects True to its monstrous name, this strain packs a ferocious physical punch that is best reserved for nighttime use or deep weekend unwinding. Born from elite Runtz genetics, the cultivar produces dense, frost-coated buds with an aromatic profile that doubles down on candy-fruit character with serious depth. Effects Double Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes premium Runtz cultivars. products.description: Strain Profile Formula One THCA Flower is a high-octane hybrid bred from E-85 crossed with Gelato #41 . The cross combines E-85's fruity gas character with Gelato 41's relaxing, dessert-rich body, producing dense, well-structured buds with deep color expression and a layered aromatic profile aimed at seasoned consumers. Effects Formula One delivers a blissful, complete experience that pairs sharp cerebral euphoria with deep body relaxation. The high lands fast and lasts, suitable for users with established tolerance who want flavor-character paired with real intensity. Best paired with downtime or evening use. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: fruity gas up front (the E-85 signature), with earthy depth through the middle and a clean lavender-pine finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and complex. The terpene profile reads fruit-and-gas with herbal accents — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Formula One harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Formula One THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Formula One THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Jealousy THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Sherbert crossed with Gelato 41 . Effects Jealousy delivers a euphoric yet deeply relaxing experience. The cerebral side stays mood-lifting and pleasant; the body baseline settles into calm, easy relaxation rather than heavy sedation. A versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding without committing to a couch-locked night. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet creamy notes up front, with bright citrus through the middle and a warm earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-rich. Clear-headed euphoria, creative momentum, zero couch-lock. The strain for getting things done while feeling very, very good about it. Burns clean, hits fast, lasts long. Brought to the United States in the 1970s, it became legendary for delivering clean, energizing effects without the paranoia or anxiety sometimes associated with potent sativas. This strain has remained genetically stable and true to its landrace origins, offering a window into pre-prohibition cannabis genetics. Durban Poison has also been used to create numerous modern hybrids, including Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie. Terpene Profile Terpinolene leads the terpene profile with sweet, herbal, and piney notes that create the distinctive anise-like aroma and provide uplifting, focusing effects. Ocimene adds floral, citrus, and herbal complexity with energizing properties that enhance mental clarity. Myrcene provides subtle earthy balance without overwhelming the strain's inherently energizing character. The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention. Hand-trimming preserves the abundant trichomes characteristic of this landrace strain. After harvest, buds

Clear-headed euphoria, creative momentum, zero couch-lock. The strain for getting things done while feeling very, very good about it. Burns clean, hits fast, lasts long. SECRET NATURE , DURBAN POISON THCA Product: Durban Poison THCA by Secret Nature URL: https://secretnature.com/products/durban-poison-thca Category: Indoor Flower Cannabinoid: THCA Potency: High Lab Results: THCA 22.25% | Total Cannabinoids 24.45% | Delta-9 THC 0.238% Flavor Profile: Indica/Rest, Gas, Cream, Earth Effects: Uplifting Pricing: 3.5 Grams ($49.00) | 7 Grams ($84.00) | 14 Grams ($162.00) | 28 Grams ($259.00) | 1 Gram ($18.00) Rating: 5 out of 5 stars from 4 verified customer reviews Tags: Flower, Hybrid, Stress Reduction, thca PRODUCT DETAILS: Genetics & Lineage Durban Poison THCA is a pure South African sativa landrace, meaning it evolved naturally over centuries in the port city of Durban without human hybridization. Brought to the United States in the 1970s, it became legendary for delivering clean, energizing effects without the paranoia or anxiety sometimes associated with potent sativas. This strain has remained genetically stable and true to its landrace origins, offering a window into pre-prohibition cannabis genetics. Durban Poison has also been used to create numerous modern hybrids, including Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie. Terpene Profile Terpinolene leads the terpene profile with sweet, herbal, and piney notes that create the distinctive anise-like aroma and provide uplifting, focusing effects. Ocimene adds floral, citrus, and herbal complexity with energizing properties that enhance mental clarity. Myrcene provides subtle earthy balance without overwhelming the strain's inherently energizing character. The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention. Hand-trimming preserves the abundant trichomes characteristic of this landrace strain. After harvest, buds

The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention. Brought to the United States in the 1970s, it became legendary for delivering clean, energizing effects without the paranoia or anxiety sometimes associated with potent sativas. This strain has remained genetically stable and true to its landrace origins, offering a window into pre-prohibition cannabis genetics. Durban Poison has also been used to create numerous modern hybrids, including Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie. Terpene Profile Terpinolene leads the terpene profile with sweet, herbal, and piney notes that create the distinctive anise-like aroma and provide uplifting, focusing effects. Ocimene adds floral, citrus, and herbal complexity with energizing properties that enhance mental clarity. Myrcene provides subtle earthy balance without overwhelming the strain's inherently energizing character. The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention. Hand-trimming preserves the abundant trichomes characteristic of this landrace strain. After harvest, buds

Clear-headed euphoria, creative momentum, zero couch-lock. The strain for getting things done while feeling very, very good about it. Burns clean, hits fast, lasts long. SECRET NATURE , DURBAN POISON THCA Product: Durban Poison THCA by Secret Nature URL: https://secretnature.com/products/durban-poison-thca Category: Indoor Flower Cannabinoid: THCA Potency: High Lab Results: THCA 22.25% | Total Cannabinoids 24.45% | Delta-9 THC 0.238% Flavor Profile: Indica/Rest, Gas, Cream, Earth Effects: Uplifting Pricing: 3.5 Grams ($49.00) | 7 Grams ($84.00) | 14 Grams ($162.00) | 28 Grams ($259.00) | 1 Gram ($18.00) Rating: 5 out of 5 stars from 4 verified customer reviews Tags: Flower, Hybrid, Stress Reduction, thca PRODUCT DETAILS: Genetics & Lineage Durban Poison THCA is a pure South African sativa landrace, meaning it evolved naturally over centuries in the port city of Durban without human hybridization. Brought to the United States in the 1970s, it became legendary for delivering clean, energizing effects without the paranoia or anxiety sometimes associated with potent sativas. This strain has remained genetically stable and true to its landrace origins, offering a window into pre-prohibition cannabis genetics. Durban Poison has also been used to create numerous modern hybrids, including Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie. Terpene Profile Terpinolene leads the terpene profile with sweet, herbal, and piney notes that create the distinctive anise-like aroma and provide uplifting, focusing effects. Ocimene adds floral, citrus, and herbal complexity with energizing properties that enhance mental clarity. Myrcene provides subtle earthy balance without overwhelming the strain's inherently energizing character. The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention. Hand-trimming preserves the abundant trichomes characteristic of this landrace strain. After harvest, buds

SECRET NATURE , PURPLE PUNCH THCA Product: Purple Punch THCA by Secret Nature URL: https://secretnature.com/products/purple-punch Category: Indoor Flower Lab Results: THC 28.80% | Total Cannabinoids 29.34% | Delta-9 THC 0.14% Flavor Profile: Sativa/Uplift, Haze, Fruit, Sweet Effects: Sleep Pricing: 3.5g ($45.00) | 7g ($85.00) | 14g ($149.00) | 28g ($249.00) | 1 Gram ($15.00) Rating: 4.8 out of 5 stars from 306 verified customer reviews Tags: Flower, Indica, Sleep, Stress Reduction, thca PRODUCT DETAILS: Genetics & Lineage Purple Punch is the cross of Larry OG (a potent OG Kush phenotype) and Granddaddy Purple (Purple Urkle x Big Bud), two legendary indica strains known for their sedative effects and rich, fruity terpene profiles. The combination amplifies the grape-berry sweetness while delivering knockout relaxation. This phenotype was selected for its vibrant purple colors, dense trichome coverage, and consistent sleep-inducing effects, making it a go-to for insomnia and chronic pain. Terpene Profile Caryophyllene dominates with peppery, anti-inflammatory qualities that promote deep physical relaxation. Myrcene adds earthy, grape-like notes with powerful sedative effects, while linalool contributes floral sweetness and anxiety-relieving properties. Together, these terpenes create a dessert-like aroma: sweet grape candy, ripe berries, and subtle earth tones. The entourage effect here is all about rest, delivering full-body calm and mental tranquility. Growing Process Cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches, Purple Punch receives meticulous care to bring out its vibrant purple hues and terpene density. The strain naturally produces dense, colorful buds, which we preserve through careful handling and cold-curing at 60°F for 14+ days. Berry sweetness on the tongue, gravity in your limbs. Your bed is going to feel magnetic tonight. SECRET NATURE , PURPLE PUNCH THCA Product: Purple Punch THCA by Secret Nature URL: https://secretnature.com/products/purple-punch Category: Indoor Flower Lab Results: THC 28.80% | Total Cannabinoids 29.34% | Delta-9 THC 0.14% Flavor Profile: Sativa/Uplift, Haze, Fruit, Sweet Effects: Sleep Pricing: 3.5g ($45.00) | 7g ($85.00) | 14g ($149.00) | 28g ($249.00) | 1 Gram ($15.00) Rating: 4.8 out of 5 stars from 306 verified customer reviews Tags: Flower, Indica, Sleep, Stress Reduction, thca PRODUCT DETAILS: Genetics & Lineage Purple Punch is the cross of Larry OG (a potent OG Kush phenotype) and Granddaddy Purple (Purple Urkle x Big Bud), two legendary indica strains known for their sedative effects and rich, fruity terpene profiles. The combination amplifies the grape-berry sweetness while delivering knockout relaxation. This phenotype was selected for its vibrant purple colors, dense trichome coverage, and consistent sleep-inducing effects, making it a go-to for insomnia and chronic pain. Terpene Profile Caryophyllene dominates with peppery, anti-inflammatory qualities that promote deep physical relaxation. Myrcene adds earthy, grape-like notes with powerful sedative effects, while linalool contributes floral sweetness and anxiety-relieving properties. Together, these terpenes create a dessert-like aroma: sweet grape candy, ripe berries, and subtle earth tones. The entourage effect here is all about rest, delivering full-body calm and mental tranquility. Growing Process Cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches, Purple Punch receives meticulous care to bring out its vibrant purple hues and terpene density. The strain naturally produces dense, colorful buds, which we preserve through careful handling and cold-curing at 60°F for 14+ days. Lolliato Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Southern Oregon Private Farm The same Southern Oregon farm responsible for the Toad Venom phenotypes that earned Herb.co’s 2026 THCa Flower Strain of the Year developed Lolliato as a separate genetic direction entirely. Where Confetti Venom takes the Toad Venom foundation and adds dimension, Lolliato is the farm pursuing a different question: what does candy-forward Gelato-family genetics look like when the farm selects specifically for lollipop-candy character and grows it in a no-till living soil environment that amplifies terpene expression at every development stage? The name answers the question directly. Lolliato is the portmanteau of lollipop and Gelato — the specific candy format that is purely sweet, purely bright, and comes in colors that are themselves the flavor indicators. Gelato genetics, developed by the Cookies Fam collective from Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC, already carry the caryophyllene-limonene-linalool terpene combination that produces the creamy, sweet, dessert character the Gelato family is known for. The lollipop parent adds the bright, singular candy-sweet dimension that pushes the profile from dessert-rich toward something more immediately striking — the candy you find at the bottom of a bag that is somehow more intensely flavored than anything else in it. Check out the full Lolliato strain writeup In living soil from the Southern Oregon farm, both the Gelato creamy depth and the lollipop candy brightness develop at full concentration. The linalool from the Gelato genetics — the floral-lavender compound that gives Gelato-family strains their smooth, rounded sweetness — accumulates more completely in the mycorrhizal root zone. The result is a terpene profile that is sweet-bright on top and creamy-dessert underneath, the candy and the cream running simultaneously rather than one following the other. This farm does not release strains it is not proud of. Lolliato is on the shelf because the Southern Oregon program earned it. Lemon Custard Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA The lemon dessert category has been one of the fastest-growing segments of the current cannabis market, and most of it lands in one of two directions: either lemon-forward with a generic sweet background, or dessert-forward with a lemon note that disappears quickly. Lemon Custard is the version that holds both simultaneously rather than sacrificing one for the other — the custard character, the warm egg-and-vanilla depth that actual custard produces, sitting beneath a bright lemon peel top note that remains specific and vivid rather than fading into generic citrus. Lemon Custard’s lineage traces to a Lemon Tree or Lemon Skunk-adjacent parent crossed with a Cookies-family or Gelato-family dessert contributor — the specific pairing that multiple breeders have converged on independently because it is the combination most likely to produce the custard character rather than just lemon-sweet or just creamy-dessert. The Lemon Tree heritage carries a specific limonene-plus-myrcene combination that produces the bright-and-grounded citrus quality — not sharp and clean like pure limonene, but warm and slightly earthy in a way that reads as the lemon in a baked custard rather than fresh-squeezed juice. The Cookies or Gelato contribution adds the vanilla and cream base that the custard name requires. Read the full Lemond Custard strain writeup What makes Lemon Custard worth growing in living soil specifically is the myrcene component. The warm, earthy depth that distinguishes the lemon custard character from generic lemon sweetness comes from the myrcene expression in the Lemon Tree-adjacent genetics — and myrcene, as documented across multiple strains in this program, develops more completely in living soil environments where the soil biology is supporting the full secondary metabolite expression rather than just the dominant limonene fraction. The citrus is present in any cultivation environment. The custard warmth that justifies the name is what the living soil is producing. The grower on this batch selected the Lemon Custard phenotype specifically for the custard note rather than for the lemon note

Candyland Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Candyland won the High Times Cannabis Cup in San Francisco in 2012. That was thirteen years ago. The fact that it is still worth growing, still worth seeking out, still sitting in the Living Soil Exotic AAA tier at a store that does not keep things on the shelf out of sentimentality — that is the whole argument for why genetics with a real lineage and a real competition history matter. The strain came from DNA Genetics working with 3rd Gen Family, crossing Grand Daddy Purple with Bay Platinum Cookies. The GDP side contributes the sweet candy terpene character, the sativa-dominant uplifting effect that runs counter to what GDP’s indica reputation would suggest, and the potential for purple coloration that develops in the right growing conditions. The Bay Platinum Cookies side contributes the fuel note, the skunky earth depth, and the potency ceiling that keeps the sativa energy from being purely airy. The combination produced an 80/20 sativa that hits fast, stays clean, and tastes like exactly what it is named after — candy with enough fuel underneath to remind you it is cannabis. Read the full candyland strain guide Four people shot footage of this strain. @blazehydro reviewed it on YouTube. Three others followed. When consumers reach for a camera before they finish the first bowl, that is a specific kind of endorsement that no product description produces. Watch those: @blazehydro THCa Review | Additional Footage | Another Review | YouTube Short The living soil cultivation is what keeps Candyland worth growing in 2026. Most commercially available Candyland is grown in synthetic nutrient programs that produce the potency and the visual but flatten the terpene complexity. The sweet candy note and the fuel depth that make the strain’s flavor profile distinctive are both terpene-dependent qualities — they require the full biochemical complexity that a living soil microbial ecosystem supports rather than just the NPK ratios that synthetic programs deliver. Jesse T found the bag loud when he popped it open. Patsy B called the living soil AAA exotics top shelf. Kenneth H stopped being skeptical. The

Yum Berry Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Also known as: Blueberry Yum Yum Blueberry Yum Yum has a name that predates the strain. Ludacris released the song in 2001, named after the specific sweet blueberry candy character that DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce when they are grown correctly — a flavor reference so specific and so recognizable that it became cultural vocabulary before anyone formalized it as a strain name. The strain named itself after the song, or the song named itself after the flavor, depending on which version of the story you prefer. Either way, when the genetics actually deliver on the name, the reference makes immediate sense. Blueberry x Durban Poison is a cross we carry in two expressions — Bali Berry and Yum Berry — because the same genetic combination produces meaningfully different phenotype expressions depending on which parent’s character dominates. Bali Berry leans toward the Durban Poison’s tropical-island brightness — the terpinolene and ocimene expression that produces the lychee-mango-adjacent complexity that distinguishes the strain from standard berry crosses. Yum Berry leans toward the Blueberry side — the linalool-forward DJ Short expression that produces the specific sweet blueberry candy note the song and the strain are both named after. Same genetics, different phenotype selection, genuinely different terpene experience. The Yum Berry phenotype was selected specifically for the Blueberry Yum Yum character — the concentrated, slightly artificial-sweet blueberry that the linalool-dominant Blueberry expression produces at its most extreme. This is not fresh blueberry or blueberry jam. It is the specific candy version of blueberry that appears in the Blueberry genetics when the linalool accumulation reaches a certain threshold. Thomas Watson described a happy, euphoric high that tastes great and looks great. That combination — the candy-sweet terpene profile producing a euphoric balanced experience — is exactly what the Blueberry Yum Yum phenotype selection was designed to deliver. The living soil cultivation does specific work with the DJ Short Blueberry genetics that is worth understanding.

Apples and Bananas crossed with Eye Candy — both from Compound Genetics, one of the most respected boutique breeding programs in the California market. Apples and Bananas is itself a four-way cross of Platinum Cookies, Gelato 41, Apple Fritter, and Blue Power, producing a complex multi-terpene profile that leans sweet and fruity with a gas depth underneath. Eye Candy, a cross of Jealousy and Runtz, adds the candy sweetness, the Gelato-family creaminess, and the balanced hybrid effect that makes the combination work across different sessions and different consumers. Blue Lobster is what Compound Genetics produced when both parents were expressing their most interesting terpene characters in the same phenotype selection. products.description: Must be 21+ to purchase. All Hemp Products sold at Sherlocks are federally compliant having less than .3% Delta 9 THC. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Street Tarts Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Purple City Genetics built Street Tarts from Guava Tart and Street Guru, and the cross landed in a specific territory between tropical fruit candy and gas-forward pastry that most strains named after confectionery never actually reach. Guava Tart brings the guava funk and tropical tartness. Street Guru brings the street-level gas depth and the urban edge that the name implies. Together they produce something that is genuinely tart in the way fruit candy is tart rather than the way generic “candy” strains approximate it — the citrus and tropical notes have an actual sour bite before the sweetness resolves. The visual is what consumers consistently mention first. Glittering purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, with a trichome architecture dense enough to reflect light. The purple coloration develops from the genetics rather than temperature stress — it is an expression of the anthocyanin compounds in the Guava Tart genetics rather than a manipulation of the environment to force color. That distinction matters in living soil cultivation: the color is the plant’s own response to the genetics under conditions that support full secondary metabolite expression. The terpene profile runs tropical, gas, and pastry simultaneously — a nose that opens with guava and tropical citrus tartness, then shifts to the Street Guru gas depth, then settles on something warm and slightly doughy underneath. That progression is what earns the “tarts” reference: a candy that opens sweet-tart and resolves to something with body. Indica-leaning hybrid. Cerebral euphoria arriving first, body weight building. This is from our private Northern California small-batch program — limited quantity, grown in living soil, not a rotating catalog item. Birthday Cake Strain THCa Flower – Light Assist Private SoCal Farm Birthday Cake originated at Kind Love dispensary in Denver in 2014 under the name Pink Cookies before arriving in Colorado with its current name. Cannarado Genetics popularized it as Birthday Cake S1 — a cross between two crosses, GSC x Cherry Pie run back against itself, stacking the dessert character from both parents at twice the concentration. The genetics are a direct ancestor of Wedding Cake and the entire dessert-Cookies lineage that defines the current premium hybrid market. This is the strain that the more famous cousins came from. The flavor profile lives up to the name in a specific rather than approximate way. The caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpene combination that Cherry Pie and GSC together produce creates a nose of sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting — the specific frosting quality that linalool’s floral warmth adds to the caryophyllene’s spiced depth, sitting above the limonene citrus brightness that keeps the dessert profile from being purely heavy. It tastes like birthday cake the food rather than birthday cake the concept, which is rarer than it sounds in a market full of dessert-named strains that deliver generic sweetness. The effects follow the same structure as the genetics: the GSC side produces the immediate euphoric mood uplift and the social ease, the Cherry Pie side grounds it in a settled indica body ease that builds through the session toward deep physical relaxation. The opening is celebratory. The finish is comfortable. The indica 60/40 lean means this session ends on the couch rather than at the party, which is the appropriate arc for a strain named after the best part of the party. Blue Dream Strain THCa Flower – Indoor Private Southern California Farm Blue Dream does not need an origin story at this point. The Blueberry x Haze cross from Santa Cruz is the most recognized sativa-dominant hybrid in American cannabis history — the strain that turned the California market toward fruit-forward sativa genetics in the mid-2000s and that has remained one of the most searched, most purchased, and most requested genetics in every legal market it has entered since. If you have been smoking cannabis long enough to have a reference point for what a sativa should feel like, Blue Dream is probably in that reference. The question is not what Blue Dream is. The question is where it comes from and how it was grown. DJ Short’s Blueberry — itself the Afghani x Purple Thai x Highland Thai cross that the cannabis community has considered one of the most important indica genetics since its release — contributes the blueberry sweetness and the indica body ease that prevents Blue Dream from being purely cerebral. The Haze parent contributes the sharp sativa energy, the creative uplift, and the citrus brightness that defines the sativa experience when Haze genetics are grown and expressed correctly. In indoor cultivation at our private Southern California farm, both contributions are present rather than one dominating. The blueberry sweetness is specific — DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce a more vivid and specific berry character than most Blueberry-named genetics available online because the lineage is documented and the cultivation environment supports full terpene expression. The Haze sativa energy is the functional, creative, clear-headed lift that made Blue Dream the go-to daytime strain for a decade before the exotic genetics market arrived and that still makes it the correct answer when someone specifically wants a classic California sativa experience rather than the newest candy cross. This is the Indoor tier — quality California indoor cultivation rather than the living soil AAA program. Then Granny Smith apple arrives — sharp and bright and not at all what the name prepared you for — and suddenly you understand why Global Genetics LA introduced this at Spannabis 2024 to the response it received. This is a candy terpene profile built on Runtz and Zkittlez genetics, which means the sweetness has depth rather than just surface. It doesn’t smell like a candy aisle. It smells like the specific piece of candy you remember eating as a child that you’ve been trying to find again ever since. The living soil cultivation is doing specific work here that is worth understanding. Blue Nerds carries a strong tendency toward purple and blue anthocyanin expression, and anthocyanin development responds to temperature cycling in ways that living soil cultivation naturally facilitates. A living soil bed — because of the thermal mass of its organic matter and microbiology — holds temperature more consistently than synthetic media but produces more natural day-to-night temperature variation than controlled indoor environments. That variation is what triggers the deepest purple expression in this genetics. Cereal Milk Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Kam T put it plainly: the cereal n milk is one of her favorites. Nice body and head high, not too strong, just right. Sweet aroma. Pleasant taste. Not too harsh. She will definitely purchase again. That review is the brief. Cereal Milk is not a strain for the consumer who wants the most intense experience in the catalog. It is the strain for the consumer who wants something that delivers on its description precisely and without demanding anything complicated in return. The name is accurate in the way that the best strain names are accurate — not a loose reference to a general flavor category but the specific sensory experience of the sweetened milk left in the bowl after the cereal is gone. Slightly sweet. Slightly creamy. Slightly artificial in the specific way that breakfast cereal sweetness is slightly artificial. Not vanilla. Not just cream. The combination that exists in that specific context and nowhere else. Cookies Fam developed Cereal Milk from Sour Dubb and Y-Life — a Girl Scout Cookies phenotype that brought the creamy dough depth, and a Sour Diesel-adjacent cross that contributed the subtle diesel funk running under the sweetness. The combination is what prevents the cereal milk character from being purely sweet — there is a savory diesel undertone at the base that makes the cream note read as complex rather than just pleasant. The pale lime green buds with lavender hues and vivid orange pistils are the Cookies-family visual that this genetics reliably produces. Read the full cereal milk strain guide The light assist cultivation is the right environment for Cereal Milk’s terpene profile specifically because the linalool and myrcene combination that produces the creamy sweetness responds better to variable light exposure than to flat artificial spectrum. The creamy note in Cereal Milk — the specific character Kam T described as pleasant and not harsh — develops more completely under the natural spectrum variation of greenhouse cultivation. Indoor-only Cereal Milk tends to read as sweet and one-dimensional. The greenhouse version has the cream and the subtle diesel depth present simultaneous

Double Stuffed Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Exotic Genetix named this one after the Oreo filling and delivered on the reference more directly than most dessert strains manage. Platinum White x Cookies and Cream produces a terpene profile where vanilla, coffee, and cream arrive together rather than one at a time — the specific combination that Oreo Double Stuff delivers when you eat it before you see it. Not just sweet. Not just creamy. The layered thing. Platinum White, itself a cross of Platinum Kush and The White, contributes the extreme trichome production architecture — The White’s trichome amplification genetics working on the Platinum Kush’s potency foundation to produce the dense crystal coating that makes Platinum White-lineage strains visually distinctive. The White has almost no terpene profile of its own, which means it amplifies whatever the other parent is doing rather than competing with it. What it amplifies here is the Cookies and Cream contribution. Cookies and Cream, a Starfighter x GSC cross from Exotic Genetix, contributes the vanilla and cream depth, the sweet earthy dough note, the dense compact bud structure, and the deeply relaxing indica body ease that makes the 70/30 indica classification accurate in effect rather than just on paper. The coffee note — the slight bitter dark roast that runs under the vanilla and cream — comes from the Starfighter genetics, which carry a specific myrcene and caryophyllene combination that reads as earthy coffee rather than just generic earthiness. The indoor cultivation is what keeps the vanilla and coffee terpene expression intact through the post-harvest process. Both compounds — the linalool that produces the vanilla sweetness and the myrcene-caryophyllene combination that produces the coffee depth — are sensitive to temperature variation in the drying room. Precise indoor humidity management from harvest through cure preserves both simultaneously, which is why the Double Stuffed name holds up when you open the jar rather than just describing what the breeder was reaching toward. Ekael N was honest — it did not look quite as colorful as the photo online, but the taste was incredible and it was the best he had tried from Sherlocks so far. products.description: Must be 21+ to purchase. All Hemp Products sold at Sherlocks are federally compliant having less than .3% Delta 9 THC. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Gas Mask Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Put the jar up to your nose before you open it. You can smell it through the lid. That is not exaggeration — the aroma on Gas Mask penetrates the seal in a way that most strains do not manage, and it is the first thing that tells you what this batch actually is before you confirm it by opening the container. Heavy fuel, skunk, and earthy pine hitting simultaneously, then the sweet cherry from the Cherry Pie genetics arriving underneath as the air settles. The name is accurate. If you have ever put on an actual gas mask and understood what the filter is meant to block out, the reference makes complete sense. Cherry Pie x Fire Alien Kush is the lineage and the combination is less obvious than it sounds. Cherry Pie — the Granddaddy Purple x F1 Durban Poison cross from the Bay Area — is known for its sweet cherry-and-berry dessert character, its purple and dark coloration, and the relaxing euphoric hybrid effect that made it a dispensary staple for years. Fire Alien Kush, bred from Fire OG and Alien Kush, is pure gas — heavy citrus fuel from the Fire OG lineage and the earthy, deeply sedative character that Alien Kush contributes from its Hindu Kush landrace roots. Crossing a dessert strain with a gas strain and getting Gas Mask as the result is not the obvious outcome. Most crosses in that direction produce something that smells either sweet-with-gas or gas-with-sweet-underneath. Gas Mask produces something where the cherry sweetness is present but the gas is so dominant that the dessert note reads as a finish rather than a feature. Check out the full Gas Mask strain writeup Scotty’s “guaranteed trip to the moon no matter what you select” is the right framing for this strain specifically. Kenneth H was skeptical first and not anymore. Isaac M would most definitely recommend. Camari H called it a five-star shop. These four reviews describe Sherlocks as a store rather than Gas Mask as a strain, which is the context worth having before you decide on this particular product — the store that put this batch on the shelf held it to the same standard as everything else you have read about on this site. Maui Wowie Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Michael got his order in about five days, tried the Maui Wowie alongside the White Widow, and was not let down compared to other vendors he had tried online. That review matters specifically because Michael named the strain — he was not reviewing the store in general or a different product, he was reviewing Maui Wowie specifically and decided it delivered. Maui Wowie has been in circulation since the 1970s. Hawaiian sativa landrace genetics, developed on the islands before most of the American cannabis market existed, selected over decades for the specific tropical fruit and citrus terpene profile and the clear, energetic, altitude-friendly high that became one of the most widely referenced cannabis experiences in the country. It has been imitated, diluted, and misrepresented on menus more than almost any other classic sativa. When it is the real genetics and it is grown correctly, the pineapple and mango note is specific and immediate — not tropical-adjacent, not citrus-forward with fruit described as tropical, but the actual Hawaiian sativa character that the original cultivars produced. Stephanie tried this batch and described a light fresh tropical smell and taste, then a hit of candy, then mint — ending in what she called eventual nirvana via a progression through calm, giggles, deep peace, and sustained tranquility throughout the body. That three-note terpene progression from tropical to candy to mint is the terpinolene expression from the Hawaiian genetics doing exactly what it evolved to do when it is given the cultivation conditions to develop fully. The light assist greenhouse is the correct environment for Maui Wowie for a reason that goes beyond the general light-assist-for-sativa explanation. Hawaiian landrace genetics evolved at altitude in the tropics — high UV exposure, warm days, cool nights, the full solar spectrum without moderation. These genetics do not respond to artificial-only spectrum the way continental sativa genetics do. They were bred for sun and they perform best when sun is part of the equation. The UV component of the greenhouse environment triggers terpinolene and ocime

Pineapple Express Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Seth Rogen and James Franco made Pineapple Express a household name in 2008. Before the film, it was a well-regarded sativa-dominant hybrid grown primarily in Hawaii and California. After the film, every cannabis operation in the country had something on the menu called Pineapple Express, and most of it had no meaningful relationship to the actual Trainwreck x Hawaiian genetics that produced the original. Carlo R called it a classic that stays in the test of time. He is right, and the cultural moment the film created is part of why — but the genetics are the deeper reason. Trainwreck x Hawaiian is a cross of two sativa-dominant genetics with genuinely complementary terpene profiles. Trainwreck, the Humboldt County three-way of Mexican Sativa, Thai Sativa, and Afghani Indica, brings the fast-acting cerebral energy, the spice and earthy lemon-lime depth, and the structural foundation. Hawaiian landrace genetics — the same source material that gave Maui Wowie its reputation — bring the tropical pineapple and citrus sweetness, the long-lasting uplifting sativa effect, and the specific Hawaiian terroir terpene expression that makes tropical fruit cannabis strains smell like actual tropical fruit rather than candy approximations. The combination produces the strain that the film was named after: sweet tropical pineapple on top, earthy spice from the Trainwreck depth underneath, a long-lasting energetic and creative high that made it the strain two people in a film about friendship and weed would chase across Los Angeles. The film made the name famous. The genetics made it worth keeping famous. Living soil is doing something specific with the Hawaiian landrace genetics in this cross. Hawaiian sativa genetics evolved outdoors with real UV exposure and complex soil biology — the same conditions that Maui Wowie requires and that we have discussed across every Hawaiian-lineage strain in the program. The pineapple and tropical fruit character in Hawaiian genetics responds to soil microbiology in ways that synthetic nutrient programs consistently underachieve. The living soil cultivation amplifies

Pure Michigan Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA ThugPug Genetics and 3rd Coast Genetics are both based in Michigan. When they collaborated on Pure Michigan they were not just naming a strain after geography — they were making a claim about what Michigan cannabis breeding had become by the time this cross was developed. Oreoz crossed with Mendo Breath F2. Oreoz itself a Cookies N Cream x Secret Weapon cross with the cookie-and-cream dessert depth and the potency ceiling that made it one of the most sought-after Cookies-adjacent genetics of the last decade. Mendo Breath F2 — the stabilized second-generation selection that ThugPug had already used in Peanut Butter Breath — contributing the heavy frost, the earthy vanilla-caramel depth, and the deeply relaxing indica body effect that Mendo Breath genetics consistently deliver. The combination produced a strain that looked unlike most of what was on the market and tasted more complex than the visual suggested it would. The visual is the first thing. Dense, heavily frosted buds that one reviewer described as a storm cloud dipped in diamonds — an overstatement that lands correctly because the trichome density on Pure Michigan at full development is genuinely unusual. The frost is not distributed evenly across the surface in the way that most high-THC genetics produce it. It accumulates in layers, the older trichomes slightly amber at the base and the newer development building on top in clear crystal. The effect of looking at a well-grown Pure Michigan bud in direct light is specific and immediately memorable. The aroma is where the Michigan claim lands. Chocolate, coffee, nutty spice, and creamy vanilla with hints of citrus and diesel depending on the cut and cure. Not a single dominant note but a layered profile that builds as the jar warms — the vanilla and caramel arriving first from the Mendo Breath genetics, then the Oreoz cookie depth, then a sharp citrus-lime note from the limonene that cuts through the warmth and makes the whole profile more complex than any single descriptor captures. Strawberry Cough Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Kyle Kushman developed Strawberry Cough from a Strawberry Fields cutting he received from a grower in Connecticut in 2000, crossed with an unknown Haze. The story goes that the first time he smoked it, the strawberry sweetness hit so intensely that it made him cough before he even exhaled. The name came from that experience rather than from marketing. Gelato 33 — the Bay Area selection from Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC that Sherbinski developed into one of the most imitated genetics of the last decade — brings the creamy ice cream sweetness, the dense trichome architecture, the euphoric balanced body ease, and the vanilla and cream depth that grounds the experience. Zkittlez, from 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz, brings the tropical candy fruit, the multi-layer brightness, and the uplifting social energy that keeps the Gelato 33 indica character from being purely sedative. The Super designation is what breeders use when a specific phenotype expresses both parent contributions at unusual intensity simultaneously — more fruit than standard Runtz, more cream than standard Zkittlez, the combination amplified rather than averaged. Jesse T found Sherlocks in a THCa Google search and the bag was loud when he popped it open. The smell was not muted like some internet THCa flower. That observation — loud, not muted — is the specific thing that the Indoor Special tier exists to deliver and the specific thing that this cross produces when the cultivation and post-harvest protocol are done correctly. The Indoor Special cultivation is the right environment for Super Runtz because Gelato 33 x Zkittlez genetics require temperature precision that outdoor and greenhouse cultivation cannot consistently provide. The vanilla and cream character from the Gelato 33 side is produced by a linalool and myrcene combination that stabilizes most completely under controlled temperatures during both flowering and cure. The tropical fruit brightness from the Zkittlez side requires the same limonene preservation that every citrus-adjacent terpene profile requires — controlled drying, low temperature, slow stabilization. Indoor cultivation handles both simultaneously. What Jesse T found loud in the bag is the result of that temperature management applied to genetics that specifically reward it. The knock on most sativa-forward flower is that it runs too fast, too cerebral, too much edge without enough ease. Trop Cherry, as it’s known in the market, was built to solve exactly that problem. Relentless Genetics crossed Tropicana Cookies with Cherry Cookies F3 and the result is a sativa-dominant hybrid that leads with bright, joyful citrus energy and lands in something genuinely comfortable rather than wired. The nose opens with ripe cherry and fresh orange simultaneously — a combination that shouldn’t work as cleanly as it does. Tangerine zest and sweet cookie dough build underneath, then a clean pine finish arrives at the back that keeps the whole profile from being one-dimensional. The smoke is smooth. The high is uplifting, creative, and functional. You stay in the world rather than floating above it. This is our Light Assist tier — greenhouse grown with real natural sunlight and supplemental lighting to extend the cycle and support terpene development. What we have noticed specifically about Tropicana Cherry Cookies in light assist cultivation is that the cherry terpene expression develops more fully under natural light than it does in full indoor. The Cherry Cookies F3 genetics carry a dark-fruit depth that requires real photon variation across the day to fully unlock. Consistent artificial spectrum tends to flatten it into generic sweetness. The greenhouse variation — morning light building through midday, softening into afternoon — pulls the cherry out of the background and puts it front and center alongside the citrus. The result is a fruit profile that is genuinely three-dimensional in a way that makes this Light Assist product punch above its tier. The grower who supplies this run has been phenotype hunting in the Trop Cherry genetics specifically for dark-fruit expression for two seasons. The current selection was chosen for the depth of the cherry note on the exhale rather than just visual bag appeal. That priority shows in the smoke. Trop
